hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'reference/ guard: jq not found, refusing Edit/Write until it is installed.' >&2; exit 2; }; p=$(jq -er '.tool_input.file_path // ""' 2>/dev/null) || { echo 'reference/ guard: unreadable hook input, refusing.' >&2; exit 2; }; lc() { printf '%s' "$1" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'; }; case "$(lc "$p")" in "$(lc "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}")"/reference/*|reference/*) echo 'reference/ is frozen provenance (recovered original firmware): never edit it. See docs/DESIGN.md §3.' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0
